description: This is a test source file for the SignalFilter class, testing filtering logic based on topics, authorization subjects, and targets in a messaging connectivity context within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: SignalFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the SignalFilter functionality, including filtering logic based on topics, authorization, and targets within the messaging system.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Provides parameterized test data, including various topic, authorization, and target configurations, with expected filtered results.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Executes the filter test by creating a connection and applying the SignalFilter to check if targets are correctly filtered according to test data.

methods.name: addAllCombinationsExpectingEmptyResult
methods.description: Generates test cases where the expected result is an empty list, covering scenarios with different topic and subject combinations.

methods.name: getCombinations
methods.description: Recursively computes all subset combinations of a given set, used for generating test cases.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Constructs different Signal objects representing various message types and topics, simulating different message scenarios for testing.
